evaluations.evidence: view a list of sponsors
evaluations.rationale: Viewing sponsors is a self-contained read capability and complementary sponsor creation/management stories (e.g., BC-028, BC-064) exist in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: view a list of user profiles
evaluations.rationale: Listing user profiles is supported and user account creation/updating exists (BC-068, BC-032), so no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: email all the trainers at once
evaluations.rationale: This is an actionable admin communication feature; trainer identity and contact exist elsewhere, so no immediate complementary capability is missing from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have a very clear map where the buildings and rooms are
evaluations.rationale: Map/room info is supported by venue and assignment stories (BC-024, BC-054), so the necessary complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: I want to edit my training node myself
evaluations.rationale: The backlog expects editable training nodes but contains no story for creating training offerings/nodes (no 'create training' story). Without a creation capability (by admin or trainer) the edit/view workflows are incomplete.

evaluations.evidence: limit to one registration per day per authenticated user
evaluations.rationale: This enforces constraints on registrations but the backlog lacks an explicit 'register for a training/class' story — the creation/registration action necessary to enforce this rule is missing.

evaluations.evidence: admin view that helps track registration status for each attendee
evaluations.rationale: Tracking registration status presumes registration records exist; backlog lacks an explicit registration/create-training-registration story to populate those statuses, so the admin view is incomplete.

evaluations.evidence: be added to a training waitlist
evaluations.rationale: Waitlisting presumes a registration mechanism and class enrollment process; no story creates the primary registration/enrollment for trainings, so waitlist functionality is unsupported by the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox
evaluations.rationale: Requiring acceptance of cancellation terms implies a cancellation workflow; the backlog does not include a story to actually cancel a registration (or to perform registration for trainings), leaving the cancellation acceptance orphaned.

evaluations.evidence: tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists
evaluations.rationale: This explicitly references a registration/cancellation workflow, but the backlog lacks the registration creation and explicit cancellation action stories required to implement that workflow.

evaluations.evidence: add to "my schedule" if there is a schedule feature on the site
evaluations.rationale: Adding items to a user's personal schedule assumes a registration/enrollment mechanism that creates those associations; the backlog lacks explicit training registration/enrollment stories to populate a personal schedule for trainings.

evaluations.evidence: see which trainings I have signed up for
evaluations.rationale: Showing a user's signed-up trainings requires a registration/booking mechanism; no training registration creation story exists to back this up, so this capability is incomplete.

evaluations.evidence: view that is attached to their training node that shows all attendee information
evaluations.rationale: Trainer attendee views assume both training nodes and attendee registrations exist; while editing and viewing are described, there is no story to create training offerings or user registrations for trainings, so the trainer view cannot be fully implemented.

evaluations.evidence: admin view where all trainee information is shown and can be filtered to show a single training session
evaluations.rationale: This admin reporting depends on trainee registration records for trainings; the backlog lacks an explicit training registration creation story to supply those records.

evaluations.evidence: dedicated page for each class ... registrations remaining, link to register for class
evaluations.rationale: The story presumes a registration mechanism (counts of remaining registrations and a register link) but no story in the backlog provides the actual registration/create-for-a-class capability, so the page cannot be made feature-complete.

evaluations.evidence: training options clearly marked ... remaining registrations, link to full details, register now link
evaluations.rationale: This listing requires registration and capacity management to be meaningful; the backlog lacks the registration creation/enrollment story required to enable 'register now' and remaining seats tracking for trainings.

evaluations.evidence: training landing page with an intro section and a list of all training offerings
evaluations.rationale: A landing page listing offerings assumes the existence/creation of training offerings; the backlog does not include a 'create training offering' story, making the feature set incomplete.

evaluations.evidence: link on the home page to a list of training options
evaluations.rationale: Linking to training options presumes those training offerings and a registration flow exist; the backlog lacks creation/registration stories for training offerings, so the link would not lead to a complete feature.

evaluations.evidence: find out where the coding lounge is and what time it is open
evaluations.rationale: Providing coding lounge location/hours is a standalone read capability; venue/location stories (BC-024, BC-025) support this requirement.

evaluations.evidence: refund sponsorship money that was processed via stripe
evaluations.rationale: Refunding payments requires payment processing and refund ability; payment stories for sponsorships (BC-023, BC-030, BC-027) exist, so the complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: find a link on the sponsorships page to become a $350 level sponsor
